create_boltzmann_policy_iteration: create a BoltzmannPolicyIteration instance for a mean-field game with a given pyspiel game and learning rate
run_boltzmann_policy_iteration_iteration: run an iteration of BoltzmannPolicyIteration to update the policy using the latest Q-function and softmax
get_boltzmann_policy_iteration_projected: get the projected policy from BoltzmannPolicyIteration as a softmax over state values with a learning rate coefficient
get_boltzmann_policy_iteration_policy: get the current policy from a BoltzmannPolicyIteration instance after running iterations
get_boltzmann_policy_iteration_distribut: get the distribution policy from BoltzmannPolicyIteration for sampling actions during mean-field evaluation
